alex: scrubber-fastpath sketch: when freeing a block, scan occupant entries; if >X% of entries are hot (recently accessed), atomically allocate an 8k target and copy only hot entries, mark the old micro-block as reclaimable without full compaction sweep. avoids global compaction pauses.

}
